articles.title: Lucy's Flyby Reveals a Tumbling, Peanut-Shaped Asteroid with a Watery Past
articles.summary: Asteroid Donaldjohanson isn't just a rock — it's a wobbling, peanut-shaped world with traces of ancient water. NASA's Lucy spacecraft captured its bizarre rotation and clay minerals during a 2025 flyby, revealing a surprisingly eventful history shaped by collisions and sunlight.

articles.title: Open-Label Placebos Boost Memory and Performance in Older Adults
articles.summary: Knowing a pill is a placebo doesn't stop it from working. In a new study, older adults who knowingly took fake pills improved memory by up to 21.5% and physical performance by 9.2% — outperforming those who were deceived. The mind-body connection is stronger than we thought.

articles.title: After 70 Years of Excavation, Ancient Sardis Earns UNESCO World Heritage Status
articles.summary: The ancient city of Sardis, where coinage was invented and civilizations layered for millennia, has joined the UNESCO World Heritage list. A Harvard-Cornell team has excavated there since 1958, uncovering everything from a gold refinery to the largest ancient synagogue — and training generations of archaeologists.
